messages:
alex.k: Hey team — we need to lock a time for the upcoming cross-team design review (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: final design sign-off and handoff to eng-runtime for the canary rollout. Please react with ✅ for any of these windows or reply if none work for you. Proposed windows:

- Tue 11/28 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 11/29 15:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 11/30 09:00–10:00 PT

Also calling out pre-read + checklist below — try to skim before the meeting so we can keep this to 60m. Pinged @maria and @devon as primary reviewers.

maria: ✅ I can do Tue or Wed, prefer Tue. Will review API surface tonight.

devon: Wed works best for me — heads up I have a conflict Tue morning.

anne.p: Thu morning open for me. Curious if you want a separate follow-up for the rollout checklist?

alex.k: If we pick Tue we'll try to land the rollout checklist in the same session (30m design, 30m rollout). If Wed/Thu we can trim rollout to a follow-up. OK either way.

jen: quick note — I haven't finished the console mock updates. If we do Tue I need until EOD Mon to finish assets.

alex.k: noted. Jen — can you post final mocks in the doc by 1701200000 (EOD Mon) so folks can preread?

jen: will do.

alex.k: Pre-read checklist (please copy into your mental checklist):

```
- Read design doc: https://redwood.company/s/designs/api-sdk-console (top section only)
- API: route surface + error behavior + telemetry hooks
- SDK: default config, auth flows, examples for bundlers
- Console: new route, permission controls, screenshot + keyboard flow
- Backwards compatibility notes for existing clients
- Open questions: rollout SLAs, fallback model variant, rate-limiting defaults
```

alex.k: Also add any blocking PRs below. If you own a code review, drop a short ETA.

maria: API PR #462 — I'm LGTM-ing but waiting on integration tests. ETA EOD Tue.

devon: SDK PR #529 — I can get a review in today, but need a second pass from eng-runtime after their perf changes.

jen: Console PR #77 — mock images uploaded, accessibility pass pending. ETA Wed morning.

anne.p: I'll own the rollout checklist note-taking during the meeting unless someone else wants it.

alex.k: thanks anne.p — big help.

devon: tiny ask — can we include the canary success criteria in the pre-read? e.g., 95th-p99 latency baseline, error budget thresholds, and rollback conditions.

alex.k: yup, adding a short section now.

alex.k: Added canary criteria to the doc. Quick copy: `p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 400ms, error rate < 0.5% over 5m window; automated rollback on >1% errors or p99 > 800ms for 3m`

maria: sounds reasonable.

jen: just uploaded final console mocks + flow notes. Link in doc.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Cross-team design review — API/SDK/Console" Wed 11/29 15:00 PT — invite: alex.k, maria, devon, anne.p, jen. (If this is incorrect react with :x:)

alex.k: Hmm deploy-bot scheduled Wed 15:00 — that's my second choice but devon preferred Wed. OK let's take the Wed slot then. Thanks bot.

maria: one more tiny ask — can the UX owner add a short 3-slide wireframe to the doc showing keyboard-first flow? helps the PMs and support teams.

jen: adding slides now, will ping when done.

devon: FYI I'll bring perf numbers for the SDK basic path and a short demo of local bundler issues.

anne.p: I'll draft the canary playbook snippet and post it to the doc before the meeting.

alex.k: perfect. If anything blocks folks update the doc or drop here. Otherwise we'll plan to meet Wed 11/29 15:00 PT and run a tight 60m: 30m design, 20m rollout, 10m action items. :thumbsup:
